{{Quote|Mr. Solo, I am ''Brother Xando''. My sect and I are on a pilgrimage to ''Norclune'', the holy planet. We seek passage on your ship.|Xando|<ref name="Tales14" />}}
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' had horns, [[Tooth/Legends|toothed]] [[Mouth/Legends|mandibles]], and glossy [[Color/Legends|dark]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], six members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] who were part of the [[Norclu Order]] were seeking to undergo a pilgrimage from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to the world of [[Norclune]]. They attempted to arrange transportation with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]; however, he refused the [[Alien/Legends|aliens']] request.

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had [[Color/Legends|reddish brown]] skin, an upright body plan, and two [[Limb/Legends|arms]] with three-digit hands. Members of the species had two large, dark red, glossy [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and, in the lower front section of their face, a pair of [[Mouth/Legends|mandibles]] that had opposing rows of [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Additionally, the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] had a pair of downward-facing outgrowths on each side of their head and four smaller ridges on their forehead. Two partially curved gray horns crowned the top of the aliens' head.<ref name="Tales14" />

==Society and culture==
Members of the species' society identified as belonging to at least one&mdash;male&mdash;[[Gender/Legends|gender]].<ref name="Tales14" />

==Xando's species in the galaxy==
{{Quote|''We'' were praying that ''you'' would bestow the trip as a gift to the Living ''Force''&mdash;once upon Norclune ''you'' and your ''ship'' shall be ''blessed''.|Xando, about the members of the Norclu Order to Han Solo|<ref name="Tales14" />}}
[[File:Xando.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Xando acted as the spokesman for the Norclu Order members' attempt to negotiate passage to Norclune.]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Smuggler's Blues]]" takes place concurrently with the portion of {{Film|IV}} that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> six members of the species, including the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]&ndash;speaking Brother [[Xando]], were part of the [[Norclu Order]] and were present at<ref name="Tales14" /> the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Seeking to undergo a pilgrimage to<ref name="Tales14" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Norclune system/Legends|Norclune system]]</ref> planet [[Norclune]], Xando and their fellow members of the order attempted at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] to negotiate passage aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|starship]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. However, the smuggler refused the aliens' request due to them being unable to pay for transportation as well as due to<ref name="Tales14" /> him<ref name="TEA" /> not sharing the order's beliefs.<ref name="Tales14" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xando's species appeared in "[[Smuggler's Blues]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by the [[Fillbach Brothers]] and included in the [[Star Wars Tales 14|fourteenth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' comic-book series by [[Dark Horse Comics]],<ref name="Tales14" /> published on [[December 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53992/star_wars_tales_1999_14|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) 14}}</ref> Plausible stories in the [[Star Wars Tales 1|first]] through [[Star Wars Tales 20|twentieth issue]] of ''Star Wars Tales'' were deemed [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref name="SWB">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref>
